description: This bar chart illustrates the GLUE Performance for different fine-tuning methods applied to RoBERTa models of two sizes—“base” and “large”—with the performance measured on a linear scale from approximately 85 to 89 on the vertical axis labeled “GLUE Performance” and the horizontal axis labeled “Fine-tuning Method” listing the methods: Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₄-model, and S₅-model. The chart uses a grouped bar format, with each method represented by two adjacent bars: a dark blue bar for the “base” RoBERTa size and a brown bar for the “large” RoBERTa size, as indicated in the legend. The performance values are approximate and visually estimated from the bar heights relative to the y-axis. For the “Prefix” method, the “base” model achieves a performance of approximately 85.2, while the “large” model achieves approximately 85.8. For “Adaptor,” the “base” model scores around 85.1 and the “large” model scores around 88.1. For “LoRA,” the “base” model scores approximately 87.1 and the “large” model scores approximately 88.9. For “BitFit,” the “base” model scores around 85.0 and the “large” model scores approximately 87.8. For the “S₁-model,” both the “base” and “large” models score approximately 85.5. For the “S₄-model,” the “base” model scores around 86.3 and the “large” model scores approximately 87.7. For the “S₅-model,” the “base” model scores approximately 87.3 and the “large” model scores approximately 89.0. The bars are not sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
